'''Pokémon Ranger the Comic: Double Mission''' (Japanese: '''{{tt|W|ダブル}} ミッションストーリー ポケモンレンジャー the Comic''' ''{{tt|W|Double}} Mission Story: Pokémon Ranger - the Comic'') is a {{pkmn|manga}} based on the W Mission of {{vg|Pokémon Ranger}}. It is written by [[Hidenori Kusaka]] and illustrated by [[Satoshi Yamamoto]]. It is set in the same continuity as [[Pokémon Adventures]], as evidenced in ''[[PS441|The Final Dimensional Duel XI]]''<!--, and takes place somewhere between {{chap|Emerald}} and {{chap|Platinum}}-->. A manga featuring the game's sequel, [[Pokémon Ranger: Shadows of Almia|Shadows of Almia]], was also released under the name [[Pokémon Ranger: The Comic – Shadows of Almia]].

The manga was available online to members of the [[Pokémon Daisuki Club]]. The first chapter is available in the book [[The Art of Pokémon Adventures]].
